Game Overview

In Chin Up Shin Up, the core idea is straightforward: help lovable pink monster Haru climb to fashion glory in Chin Up Shin Up. Quick reflexes are key as you collect gold for trendy accessories, dodge menacing spikes, and outsmart the pursuing Sheriff. With vibrant visuals and endless action, this quirky ascent promises a thrilling and stylish adventure.
